Implementation of a scheduler for callback functions.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This implementation enables the planning of {\color{red}\bfseries{}|Job|}s depending on time
cycles, fixed times, weekdays, dates, offsets, execution counts and weights.
\subsubsection*{Notes}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Due to the support of \sphinxtitleref{datetime} objects, \sphinxtitleref{scheduler} is able to work
with timezones.
